method: people -> organizations -> public members and leadership -> documented U.S. ties

targets.title: Resolve every Yesha Council board member's U.S. activity
collect: U.S. nonprofit board, officer, contractor, or speaker roles
public remarks about sovereignty, annexation, settlements, or Palestinian statehood
targets.stop_condition: Each official board-page entry has either a source-backed U.S. tie or an explicit unresolved result with searched source classes.

targets.title: Normalize American Friends of Judea and Samaria
seed_entities: American Friends of Judea and Samaria
collect: officers, directors, key employees, and compensation
grants, contractors, related organizations, and foreign transfers
targets.stop_condition: A year-by-year officer, revenue, expense, grant, project, and related-party graph exists for all available filing years.

targets.title: Resolve The Regavim Policy Forum's U.S. structure and flows
collect: payments or grants to Regavim in Israel
targets.stop_condition: U.S.-to-Israel money flows are resolved by year, amount, recipient, and source filing.

targets.title: Resolve Ruth Lieberman's foundation and delegation infrastructure
collect: exact foundation legal name and EIN
Washington meeting calendars and public statements
targets.stop_condition: The foundation is legally resolved and every documented trip or delegation has participants, sponsor, dates, locations, and sources.

targets.title: Crosswalk USIEA congressional travel to policy activity
collect: subsequent bills, letters, hearings, votes, and public statements
targets.analytic_constraint: Report chronology and overlap; do not claim travel caused later policy without direct evidence.
targets.stop_condition: Every identified trip is mapped to participants, sponsor, itinerary, costs, briefers, and subsequent public actions.

targets.title: Resolve Keep God's Land's claimed Jewish-Christian coalition
targets.stop_condition: The coalition's public membership, organizers, events, money, and institutional partners are normalized with source confidence.

targets.title: Trace the origin and promotion of H.R. 902 and S. 384
collect: events and media promoting the terminology change
targets.stop_condition: A source-backed drafting, endorsement, lobbying, sponsorship, and committee-action chronology exists.

targets.title: Decompose the December 2025 ZOA House testimony
collect: public pre-hearing coordination or joint events
post-hearing reuse in legislation, media, and advocacy
targets.analytic_constraint: Source citation establishes amplification; coordination requires additional evidence.
targets.stop_condition: Every substantive claim and cited source in the testimony is represented as a claim-source-person-organization graph.

targets.title: Resolve Central Fund of Israel grant recipients
collect: links to Amana, Nachala, Regavim, Hashomer Yosh, councils, farms, and outposts
grant purpose and amount by year
targets.analytic_constraint: Do not attribute a grant to a named organization without a filing, recipient acknowledgment, or equivalent direct evidence.
targets.stop_condition: All discoverable foreign grants are entity-resolved and linked to legal recipients, amounts, purposes, and years.

targets.title: Map One Israel Fund projects to councils, recipients, and vendors
targets.stop_condition: Each funded project has a year, amount, beneficiary, locale, council, vendor where public, and source.

targets.title: Resolve Hebron Fund people and Israeli endpoints
collect: officers, directors, compensation, and related parties
property, security, education, tourism, and infrastructure projects
overlap with Eyal Gelman and other Hebron public officials
targets.stop_condition: U.S. people and money are linked to legally resolved Israeli recipients and projects by filing year.

targets.title: Reconcile American Friends of Ateret Cohanim and Israeli entities
targets.stop_condition: U.S. and Israeli legal entities, people, grants, properties, and proceedings are disambiguated.

targets.title: Resolve Nachala's U.S. donation and partner structure
collect: website payment processor and merchant identity
partner agreement with Jewish Heritage Project
targets.stop_condition: Every public donation route is linked to a legal recipient, processor, officers, and downstream project evidence.

targets.title: Trace U.S. support and entities connected to Amana
collect: current leadership and Israeli registry records
construction projects, land companies, contractors, and councils
effects of U.S. sanctions and January 2025 termination
targets.analytic_constraint: Preserve sanctions as attributed government determinations; separately establish transactions and legal relationships.
targets.stop_condition: A time-bounded organization-person-company-project-money graph exists before, during, and after U.S. sanctions.

targets.title: Disambiguate Hashomer Yosh from HaShomer HaChadash
collect: shared people, addresses, projects, or branding if any
targets.analytic_constraint: Do not merge the organizations because their English names are similar.
targets.stop_condition: Each entity has separate identifiers, personnel, money routes, projects, and evidence-backed relations.
